project: Titli Foundation - Premium NGO Landing Page
theme_strategy: Light Cream base with high-contrast Ink dark mode sections. Titli Pink acts as the functional and emotional kinetic trigger. Aesthetic is Apple/UNICEF Editorial quality.

scales.h1: text-6xl md:text-[80px] lg:text-[120px] leading-[0.9] tracking-tighter font-medium font-['Fraunces']
scales.h2: text-4xl md:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-tight font-['Inter'] font-semibold

section_1_navigation.layout: fixed top-0 w-full z-50 px-6 md:px-12 xl:px-[240px] py-4
section_1_navigation.elements: Left: Text Logo in Inter bold, Center: Hidden on mobile, 4 links Inter text-sm, Right: Titli Pink Pill Donate Button

section_2_hero.layout: min-h-[90vh] flex flex-col justify-center px-6 md:px-12 xl:px-[240px] pt-[120px] pb-24 relative overflow-hidden
elements: H1 Fraunces Masked line-by-line reveal via Framer Motion. Text: 'Empowering futures, one classroom at a time.'
Script accent: 'cup' text or svg circled over 'futures' in Shadows Into Light pink.
Image: Right-aligned or floating Spotlight clipped frame (rounded-[40px]) with parallax scroll. Use hero image.
Floating Glass Card: Absolute positioned overlapping bottom-left of image, frosted glass (bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-md) showing '10K+ Students Impacted'

section_3_trust_metrics.layout: grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-8 px-6 md:px-12 xl:px-[240px] py-16 md:py-24 border-t border-[#000000]/10
section_3_trust_metrics.elements: 4 Cards. Huge Inter bold numbers using react-countup. Small uppercase tracking-widest overlines (text-xs).

section_4_how_it_works.layout: max-w-4xl mx-auto px-6 md:px-12 py-24 md:py-32 flex flex-col gap-16 relative
elements: Numbered Chapters: 01, 02, 03 in Fraunces text-4xl text-[#000000]/20
Dotted Pink SVG line connecting steps vertically, drawn on scroll using Framer Motion pathLength.

section_5_why_join.layout: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-[32px] px-6 md:px-12 xl:px-[240px] py-24
section_5_why_join.style: Bento boxes use rounded-[28px] or rounded-[40px] with bg-[#FEF1F8] or white + soft shadow.
section_5_why_join.spans: Box 1: col-span-12 md:col-span-8. Box 2: col-span-12 md:col-span-4. Box 3: col-span-12 md:col-span-4. Box 4: col-span-12 md:col-span-8.

section_6_privacy_trust.layout: bg-[#000000] text-white py-[160px] px-6 md:px-12 xl:px-[240px] flex flex-col md:flex-row gap-16
section_6_privacy_trust.elements: Left: Fraunces H2 text-white. Right: 2 Glass Cards (bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/20 rounded-[28px] p-8) showing certifications/trust.

section_7_stories_of_impact.elements: Embla carousel. Cards are w-[85vw] md:w-[60vw] lg:w-[40vw] mr-8 shrink-0 relative rounded-[40px] overflow-hidden group.
section_7_stories_of_impact.style: Image fills card. Dark gradient overlay bottom. Text at bottom. Subtle zoom on image hover.

Center: Absolute floating Glass Card (India Map Vector or text 'Operating in 50+ Regions') with high z-index and heavy shadow.

section_9_final_cta.layout: mx-6 md:mx-12 xl:mx-[240px] rounded-[40px] overflow-hidden relative min-h-[600px] flex items-center justify-center text-center p-8
section_9_final_cta.style: Background Image with bg-gradient-to-t from-black/80 via-black/40 to-transparent overlay. Text is white.

section_10_footer.layout: bg-[#000000] text-[#FFFFFF] pt-32 pb-12 px-6 md:px-12 xl:px-[240px]
section_10_footer.elements: Top: Newsletter signup (Input + Submit Button in white). Middle: Grid of link columns. Bottom: Socials and copyright.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You MUST use Lenis for smooth scrolling across the entire app for a premium feel.
Do NOT use pure #000000 unless specified in the locked tokens. We use #000000 (Ink) only for the dark sections.
All headings H1-H3 MUST have tracking-tight or tracking-tighter applied.
Do NOT use transparent navigation backgrounds when content scrolls beneath it. Use glassmorphism: bg-[#FFFBF7]/80 and backdrop-blur-xl.
Use Framer Motion for line-by-line reveal in the Hero section and pathLength animation for the stepper connector.
Always provide data-testid for all interactive components.
The Hero image overlay must NEVER be fully transparent. Do not use generic full-screen gradients. Provide spotlight or clipped frame designs.
